# Sageon Media

> Sageon Media is a web development agency specializing in fast, modern, SEO-optimized responsive websites, landing pages, multi-page business applications, e-commerce stores, and digital maintenance.

## Navigation & Core Pages

- [Sākums](https://sageonmedia.eu/): Agency overview, workflow stages, interactive pricing calculator, and core service offerings.
- [Mūsu Darbi / Portfolio](https://sageonmedia.eu/portfolio): Real client work showcase (including Avenue Group, Travel with Martins, Avangart) and project inquiry forms.
- [Pakalpojumi un Cenas](https://sageonmedia.eu/pakalpojumi): Pricing plans (Landing page from €490, Multi-page from €1290, E-commerce from €1890, Maintenance from €50/mo).
- [Biežāk Uzdotie Jautājumi (BUJ)](https://sageonmedia.eu/buj): Development timelines (5-7 days for landing pages, 2-3 weeks for multi-page), payment terms, security, and mobile optimization FAQs.
- [Blogs](https://sageonmedia.eu/blogs): Articles and expert insights on web development, SEO optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [Kontakti](https://sageonmedia.eu/kontakti): Contact information, direct inquiry form, email, and phone contact details.
